If U_+ is intended to be the coordinate-index union of S_+, then a^+(U_+) uses r^+ at a different type and needs an explicit definition plus U_+ = union_{Q in S_+} Q; if it is a family of fibers, that typing must be stated. The elementary monotonicity would be valid after these bindings, but as written the node relies on missing context and cannot be independently verified from the permitted definitions/ancestor.
